v = int(input())
sequence = [0] * 17
sequence[0] = 1
for i in range(1, 17):
    sequence[i] = sequence[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def solve(index, value):
    value = abs(value)
    if index == 0:
        return int(value)
    base = int(value // sequence[index])
    next_base = base + 1
    cost_option1 = base * (index + 1) + solve(index - 1, value - base * sequence[index])
    cost_option2 = next_base * (index + 1) + solve(index - 1, value - next_base * sequence[index])
    return min(cost_option1, cost_option2)

print(solve(16, v))
